name: data/json-tool
title: JSON reshape tool
summary: Python script that reads JSON, picks and renames fields, filters records and writes JSON or CSV.
when: Use when the user has a JSON file and wants only some fields, renamed or filtered, out as JSON or CSV.

name.about: Script name: file stem, prog name in the help text and the logger name.

next: Write every file under files/ into the user's project, then run python3 {{name}}.py sample.json --pick <fields> --format csv --out out.csv and python3 -m pytest -q.
